chunks: And it is narrated from Abu Abdillah (peace be upon him) who said:
Whoever is afflicted with an illness and begins with the clay of the grave of Al-Husayn (peace be upon him), Allah will cure him of that illness, unless it is the illness of death.

key_terms.طِينُ قَبْرِ الْحُسَيْنِ: clay of the grave of Al-Husayn

ai.seo_question: What is the spiritual and physical benefit of using the clay from Imam Husayn's grave for curing illness?
ai.summary: In Shia tradition, the clay (turab) of Imam Al-Husayn’s grave is revered as a potent spiritual remedy, reflecting the belief in the intercessory power of the Ahl al-Bayt. The exception of 'illat al-sam' (death) underscores that while physical ailments may be cured, the ultimate decree of mortality remains under divine will. This practice is deeply rooted in the concept of barakah associated with the graves of the Imams, serving as a tangible link to their spiritual presence.
